Building Reliable Conversion Pipelines

By Alex Example

Reliable document conversion starts by separating content extraction from output formatting. Each stage can then be tested independently, observed clearly, and replaced without changing the rest of the pipeline. This approach also produces useful error messages when a page does not contain a conventional article structure.

Extract the meaningful content

A mature readability algorithm scores candidate elements, ignores navigation and advertising, and preserves the headings, links, images, lists, and code blocks that belong to the article. See the extraction guide for a complete example. 

const markdown = convert(article.content)
StageResponsibility
ReadabilityExtract content

The final Markdown should remain useful when copied into a repository, note-taking application, or static site generator. Deterministic fixtures and browser-level tests protect that behavior.
